### [Building safeguards for Claude](https://www.anthropic.com/news/building-safeguards-for-claude)

**Anthropic** · 2026-10-19

Anthropic's Safeguards team implements a multi-layered defense strategy—spanning policy development, training, pre-deployment evaluations, real-time classifiers, and threat intelligence—to prevent misuse across Claude's entire lifecycle.

- The Safeguards team includes cross-functional experts across policy, enforcement, product, data science, threat intelligence, and engineering.
- Protections operate across five distinct layers: policy creation, model training influence, pre-deployment output testing, real-time enforcement, and novel attack identification.
- The Usage Policy establishes operational boundaries for critical domains, including child safety, election integrity, cybersecurity, healthcare, and finance.

**Why it matters:** Establishing multi-layered safeguards across the full model lifecycle helps prevent real-world harms and malicious exploitation while maintaining model utility in sensitive domains like healthcare and finance.

### [Our compliance framework for California&#x27;s SB 53](https://www.anthropic.com/news/compliance-framework-SB53)

**Anthropic** · 2026-10-19

Anthropic released its Frontier Compliance Framework to fulfill public disclosure requirements for assessing and mitigating catastrophic AI risks under California's Transparency in Frontier AI Act (SB 53), effective January 1.

- Outlines methods to assess and mitigate cyber offense, CBRN (chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear) threats, AI sabotage, and loss of control.
- Establishes a tiered evaluation system to benchmark model capabilities against specific catastrophic risk categories.
- Details operational protocols for protecting model weights, mitigating identified risks, and responding to safety incidents.
- Evolves safety practices previously established in Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy (RSP) and model system cards into a legally required framework.

**Why it matters:** The framework converts voluntary safety practices, like capability evaluations and incident reporting, into a mandatory compliance standard for frontier AI developers operating in California.

### [FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making](https://huggingface.co/blog/allenai/fairstress)

**Hugging Face** · 2026-10-20

The FairStress evaluation framework assesses the robustness of fairness in large language model decision-making processes under systematic stress conditions.

- FairStress introduces targeted stress testing to evaluate LLM fairness beyond standard, static benchmark metrics.
- The benchmark measures demographic bias and decision-making stability across varying prompt perturbations and contextual stressors.
- Results highlight failure modes where models exhibit increased bias when exposed to complex or adversarial decision scenarios.

**Why it matters:** Evaluating LLM fairness under stress conditions provides a more reliable assessment of model safety before deploying AI decision-making systems in high-stakes real-world environments.

### [Expanding Project Glasswing](https://www.anthropic.com/news/expanding-project-glasswing)

**Anthropic** · 2026-10-19

Anthropic is expanding Project Glasswing to approximately 150 new organizations across more than 15 countries to scan critical codebases using Claude Mythos Preview.

- Initial cohort of roughly 50 partners identified over 10,000 high- or critical-severity software vulnerabilities using Claude Mythos Preview.
- New cohort expands coverage to essential sectors including power, water, healthcare, communications, hardware, and major software vendors.
- Participating organizations must meet specific security requirements prior to receiving model access.
- Targeted partners maintain codebases where successful cyberattacks could impact over 100 million people and threaten global or national security.

**Why it matters:** Scaling AI-driven vulnerability scanning across critical infrastructure vendors aims to secure foundational software ecosystems against catastrophic cyberattacks.
